scope: National Rail Museum at Chanakyapuri in its October 2023 appearance, including the octagonal Indoor Gallery, fixed outdoor tracks and turntable, open-sided rolling-stock display canopies, Rail Cafeteria and mapped service buildings.

quallaSearch.notes: Inspected the exact original train photographs already cleared on the Qualla story. Five selected creator-dedicated CC0 photographs show distinctive fixed rail-yard structures and materials around the vehicles. Qualla’s entrance and shed photos have attribution-share-alike licenses and were excluded. The gallery building has independently mapped outline and conservatively estimated exterior sections.
